summary: Iteration 3 verification of the 4 refinement areas. Backend: 50 pytest cases (new /app/backend/tests/test_iteration3.py + test_privacy_probe.py, plus the iteration-2 suite) -> 49 pass, 1 fails and exposes a genuine privacy leak. Frontend (Playwright, Chromium 1920x1080): instrument search finds ASTOR by symbol (upper/lower case) and by company name ('enerji' -> 6 tickers incl. ASTOR), tx-inst-row-ASTOR selectable, buy 10@130 saves with toast 'İşlem kaydedildi' and lands on /portfolio with ASTOR 70->80; dividend flow adds ASTOR 500 -> kpi-dividends 2.900,00 -> 3.400,00, cash +500, ASTOR quantity UNCHANGED (80), ASTOR chip 1.250 -> 1.750 and new row visible in 'Temettü Geçmişi'; public /u/deniz.yatirim shows 'Portföy Özeti — Beyan Edilen Pozisyonlar' with alloc-bar, alloc-seg-ASTOR/THYAO and zero ₺ characters (unauthenticated AND as Ece); compose disclosure picker is correctly restricted to held tickers (SISE rejected with 'Portföyünüzde eşleşen hisse yok.') and auto-fills to ASTOR from the ticker tag; golden feed renders ASTOR 8,40 / 4,20 and THYAO 6,18 / 2,60 with populated current_position and ↓ Azalttı. Regression OK: login/logout/session persistence, notifications bell, alerts CRUD (POST/GET/PATCH/DELETE), alerts page, feed, media 206. All test-created transactions on Deniz were deleted; golden state restored (12 txs, total_dividends 2900, ASTOR 70 @ %8,05, THYAO 18 @ %1,85).

critical.issue: PRIVACY LEAK — the endpoint returns history[].allocation_at_publication taken from disclosure.underlying_allocation_pct and a live current.allocation_pct WITHOUT checking the post's own privacy flags. Reproduced: a post published with show_allocation=false / allocation_mode='hidden' (disclosed_allocation_pct=null) still exposes allocation_at_publication=27.7399 and current=27.7399 to any unauthenticated caller. /api/feed and /api/posts/{id} are worse: _hydrate_post returns the raw disclosure dict verbatim, so underlying_allocation_pct AND underlying_quantity are shipped to every viewer even when show_allocation/show_quantity are false (the UI just doesn't render them). Fix: strip underlying_* server-side and only expose disclosed_allocation_pct / disclosed_range; skip hidden posts in /disclosures. Repro test: tests/test_privacy_probe.py::test_hidden_allocation_is_not_leaked_by_disclosures

minor.issue: Hardcodes market_data_source: 'demo' while MARKET_DATA_PROVIDER=yahoo is actually active — should read get_market_data_provider().name.
Decorator @api.get('/notifications') is duplicated (server.py L727-728) — registers the same route twice.

Filter + sort run on every request over the full universe with no pagination metadata (no total count) and limit default 200 > universe size; harmless now, but the frontend combobox re-queries on every keystroke with no debounce (InstrumentPicker useEffect on q) — ~1 request per typed character.
Re-values the whole portfolio for every transaction (N valuations, N quote lookups); series x-axis mixes 2025 and 2026 dates so the chart's last segment is a flat 1-year line.

integration_issues.issue: The 'Beyan Edilen Pozisyonlar' bar/chips are built from d.current.allocation_pct (the author's LIVE weight), not from what was actually disclosed. Copy says 'Yalnızca kullanıcının gönderilerde açıkça paylaştığı ağırlıklar gösterilir' but after I added a test buy the public bar instantly moved 8,05% -> 9,12% although Deniz never published that. This is the same root cause as the backend privacy leak — the public surface tracks the private portfolio in real time.

The 2nd ASTOR post text says 'ASTOR pozisyonumu %8'den yaklaşık yarısına indirdim' and discloses 4,20 while the current position is 8,05 -> the disclosure card shows '↑ Artırdı' and the profile row shows 'Son beyan %4,20 / Güncel %8,05 Artırdı'. seed_demo never writes the ASTOR sell, so the demo story contradicts the widget. Either add the ASTOR trim sell tx or change the post copy.

issues: Sonner toast renders top-center and sits ON TOP of the header nav, hiding the 'Akış/Portföy/Profil' links for ~4s after every save — move the toaster to top-right/bottom or offset below the 56px header.
Recharts logs 'The width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0' on every mount (ResponsiveContainer measured before layout) — add minWidth/minHeight.
Tooltip stays pinned after the pointer leaves the chart area.
Date field uses the native browser <input type=date> picker instead of the shadcn Calendar/Popover used elsewhere — inconsistent with the visual system.
No keyboard navigation (arrow keys / Enter) and no role=listbox/option semantics; rows are plain buttons, so the combobox is mouse-only and not screen-reader friendly.

action_items: CRITICAL: stop leaking underlying_allocation_pct / underlying_quantity. Sanitize the disclosure object in _hydrate_post (keep only ticker, disclosed_allocation_pct, disclosed_range, show_* flags, snapshot_at) and make /users/{u}/disclosures respect show_allocation and allocation_mode ('hidden' posts must not contribute a number).

Decide the intended semantics of the public 'Portföy Özeti' bar: if it must stay privacy-preserving it should aggregate last_disclosed values, not the live current allocation (today it republishes every portfolio change automatically).
Fix the ASTOR demo narrative: seed the ASTOR trim sell (or reword the post) so the '4,20 published vs 8,05 current' card no longer reads '↑ Artırdı' under text saying the position was halved.
GET /api/ should report the real provider name instead of the hardcoded 'demo'.
Debounce InstrumentPicker's search (currently 1 XHR per keystroke) and add keyboard navigation/aria roles.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py::_hydrate_post spreads the stored post ({**post}) straight into the API response, so any field added to the disclosure snapshot is automatically public. Privacy-sensitive documents must be serialised through an explicit response model, not spread.
server.py is 792 lines with auth, portfolio, market, social, uploads, notifications and alerts in one module — split into routers.
Profile.js embeds a ~45-line IIFE for the allocation bar inside JSX; extract into an <AllocationBar/> component (also makes the disclosed-vs-current decision explicit).

Portfolio.js: the dividend section is another large inline IIFE and the file has two blocks labelled '{/* Transactions */}'; the dividend aggregation should be computed by the backend (it already knows h.dividends) instead of re-deriving from the raw tx list on the client.

InstrumentPicker fetches /market/tickers on every keystroke and again for the selected value; no debounce, no abort of in-flight requests (only an `alive` guard), and no error state if the request fails (dropdown silently shows 'sonuç bulunamadı').

rca_of_the_issue: Privacy leak RCA: _snapshot_disclosure() stores both the real values (underlying_allocation_pct, underlying_quantity) and the user-consented values (disclosed_allocation_pct, disclosed_range) in the same embedded document. _hydrate_post then returns the post document verbatim ({**post}), and user_disclosures() reads d['underlying_allocation_pct'] unconditionally. Consequently the privacy switches in Compose (switch-alloc, alloc-mode='hidden', switch-qty, switch-value) are enforced only in the React renderer, not by the API: a curl against /api/feed or /api/users/{u}/disclosures returns the exact private allocation (and quantity when recorded) for every disclosed post. Verified with a throwaway account that published show_allocation=false/allocation_mode='hidden' — /disclosures returned allocation_at_publication=27.7399. Not fixed here (business logic); the failing test is left in place as the regression guard.
